938025:
**Steps:**
- First, complete the [Pack-A-Punch Upgrade Easter Egg](#loc=938030).
- Head to Dravakar's temple and acquire the [Fracture of Nyxara](#loc=938031).
- Then, head to Nyxara Main Chamber and slot the fracture into the empty slot high up on one of the walls.
- Head back to the Nexus Forge and grab the purple flame.
- Throw the purple flame at the [Eye Altar](#loc=938032). This will create a beam to the other crystals in the room.
- Use the void claw to realign the crystals so they bounce off each other until the projectile goes into a closed door to enter Nyxara Inner Sanctum.
- Interact with the orb behind the door then head down to the lower area.
- Interact with the vines and let it drain your health, then interact with the fruit. (The Fruit will not spawn until Round 8)
- You'll be teleported to a forest. Find the three corpses around the forest and grab the pieces of the wonder weapon:
   - [Wonder Weapon Part](#loc=938033)
   - [Wonder Weapon Part](#loc=938034)
   - [Wonder Weapon Part](#loc=938035)
- Head to the Dravakar Temple and interact with the [Writing on Wall](#loc=938036) to receive a phrase.
- There are four symbol pillars that can be rotated around the room:
   - [Void Pillar](#loc=938037)
   - [Moon Pillar](#loc=938038)
   - [Sun Pillar](#loc=938039)
   - [Comet Pillar](#loc=938040)
- There are also three levers around that rotate the symbols:
   - [Lever](#loc=938043)
   - [Lever](#loc=938042)
   - [Lever](#loc=938041)
- Depending on the phrase, the symbols will need to be facing a certain direction:
   - If the phrase is **I drift to stars that remember moons, who borrow the runner that travels the galaxy.**:
      - Rotate the left lever once.
      - Rotate the back lever twice.
      - Rotate the right lever twice.
   - If the phrase is **I drift to the runner that travels to the Moon, who borrows from galaxies when stars stay true.**:
      - Rotate the left lever three times.
      - Rotate the back lever twice.
      - Rotate the right lever once.
   - If the phrase is **I remember the runner that travels to stars, while moons and galaxies stay true.**:
      - Rotate the back lever twice.
      - Rotate the right lever three times.
   - If the phrase is **I remember galaxies that drift to moons, who borrow the runner that travels the stars.**:
      - Rotate the left lever twice.
      - Rotate the right lever twice.
- Once done, pull the middle lever to lower the pillar.
- Grapple to the area up above and interact with the [Dravakar's Anvil](#loc=938044) to build the Warden's Blight wonder weapon.
- Returning to the house can be down simultaneously as completing the other temples:
   - Head to the nexus forge and shoot the [Basketball](#loc=938045) from the roof of the house. 
   - Every round, head to the house and mark down which symbol spawned when. 
   - On the next exfil round, shoot the symbols on the house in the order they appear.
   - Interact with the exfil and kill the HVT.
   - Teleporting at the exfil will bring you back to the house.
   - Head upstairs and shoot the ground behind the window with the Charged Warden's Blight that's Pack-A-Punched to receive the [Eye of the Forge](#loc=938105).
   - Bring the Eye of the Forge to a void pedestal to upgrade it to the void talon.
- Head to Veytharion's temple and pick up the four stone blocks on the ground around the area:
   - [Stone Block](#loc=938049)
   - [Stone Block](#loc=938047)
   - [Stone Block](#loc=938050)
   - [Stone Block](#loc=938046)
- Place all four blocks into the [Elemental Block Wall](#loc=938048) in one of these orders:
   - Fire -> Air -> Water -> Earth
   - Fire -> Air -> Earth -> Water
   - Earth -> Water -> Air -> Fire
   - Water -> Earth -> Air -> Fire
- Then move the blocks in this order back and forth:
   - Move Fire and Air from left to right.
   - Drop off Fire then move Air from right to left.
   - Pick up Water and move Air and Water from left to right.
   - Drop off Air then Water, pick up Fire then Air, and move Fire from right to left.
   - Drop off Air then Fire, pick up Earth then Air, and move Earth and Air from left to right.
   - Drop off Earth and move Air from right to left.
   - Pick up Fire and move Air and Fire from left to right.
   - Drop off Air then Fire.
- This will reveal the [Pool](#loc=938051) behind the wall.
- Head to Caltheris temple and head to the [Floor Switches](#loc=938052).
- Stand on each plate from left to right and shoot the lights that appear.
- Once completed, a wall will open, revealing two orbs and a lantern.
- Interact with both orbs.
- Next, four corruptions are required to cleanse each temple:
   - [Shimmering Thread](#loc=938053)
   - [Ancient Scroll](#loc=938055)
   - [Blacksmith's Hammer](#loc=938077)
   - Woven Sash:
      - [Woven Sash Possible Spawn](#loc=938094)
      - [Woven Sash Possible Spawn](#loc=938093)
      - [Woven Sash Possible Spawn](#loc=938092)
- With the upgraded void talon and the four corruptions, pull a purple orb to the [Pack-A-Punch Machine](#loc=935472).
- Spin the wheel around the Pack-A-Punch to surge the nexus.
- Grab a void talon and pull off the eye symbols above each of the walls in the nexus core.
- Burn away the spider webs clogging the gears then head back up.
- Use the void talon to remove the eye symbols from the sides of the pillars surrounding the nexus.
- Crank the nexus then interact with the levers to start building the nexus.
- Place a purple orb in and crank it a few times then pull the lever on the ground in the core to lock it in place. The pillars can now be moved.
- All three pillars will need to line up and face a temple to cleanse it.
- Caltheris:
   - Head to the Caltheris Temple and place the Shimmering Thread inside the [Brazier](#loc=938117).
   - Throw an astral flame inside and a nearby zombie should glow.
   - Bring that to the [Titan Trap](#loc=935507) and have it die by the trap.
   - Stand on the [Pressure Plate](#loc=938118) and ADS to release the plate.
   - Shoot the disc on the ground with a charged wonder weapon shot to raise it.
   - Shoot it to align it to the wall in front of the [Head Statue](#loc=938119).
   - Kill zombies underneath the beam to blow open the wall.
   - Shoot the Head Statue and find the nearby Shadow Zombies.
   - Kill the Shadow Zombies then shoot the Head Statue until the event is over.
   - Head outside and bring a purple orb underneath Caltheris' head, then shoot it with the wonder weapon to bring it up to its head.
   - While it's raining, get an Astral Flame and throw it at the head to strike it with lightning.
- Nyxara:
   - Head to the Nyxara Temple and place the Ancient Scroll inside the [Brazier](#loc=938125).
   - Throw an astral flame inside and a nearby zombie should glow.
   - Bring that to the [Titan Trap](#loc=935412) and have it die by the trap.
   - Prone on the [Pressure Plate](#loc=938124) to release the plate.
   - Shoot the disc on the ground with a charged wonder weapon shot to raise it.
   - Shoot it to align it to the wall in front of the [Head Statue](#loc=938126).
   - Kill zombies underneath the beam to blow open the wall.
   - Shoot the Head Statue and find the nearby Shadow Zombies.
   - Kill the Shadow Zombies then shoot the Head Statue until the event is over.
   - Head outside and bring a purple orb underneath Nyxara's head, then shoot it with the wonder weapon to bring it up to its head.
   - While it's raining, get an Astral Flame and throw it at the head to strike it with lightning.
- Veytharion:
   - Head to the Veytharion Temple and place the Woven Sash inside the [Brazier](#loc=938123).
   - Throw an astral flame inside and a nearby zombie should glow.
   - Bring that to the [Titan Trap](#loc=935412) and have it die by the trap.
   - Jump over and over on the [Pressure Plate](#loc=938122) to release the plate.
   - Shoot the disc on the ground with a charged wonder weapon shot to raise it.
   - Shoot it to align it to the wall in front of the [Head Statue](#loc=938127).
   - Kill zombies underneath the beam to blow open the wall.
   - Shoot the Head Statue and find the nearby Shadow Zombies.
   - Kill the Shadow Zombies then shoot the Head Statue until the event is over.
   - Head outside and bring a purple orb underneath Veytharion's head, then shoot it with the wonder weapon to bring it up to its head.
   - While it's raining, get an Astral Flame and throw it at the head to strike it with lightning.
- Dravakar:
   - Head to the Dravakar Temple and place The Hammer inside the [Brazier](#loc=938121).
   - Throw an astral flame inside and a nearby zombie should glow.
   - Bring that to the [Titan Trap](#loc=935507) and have it die by the trap.
   - Plate your armor on the [Pressure Plate](#loc=938120) to release the plate.
   - Shoot the disc on the ground with a charged wonder weapon shot to raise it.
   - Shoot it to align it to the wall in front of the [Head Statue](#loc=938128).
   - Kill zombies underneath the beam to blow open the wall.
   - Shoot the Head Statue and find the nearby Shadow Zombies.
   - Kill the Shadow Zombies then shoot the Head Statue until the event is over.
   - Head outside and bring a purple orb underneath Dravakar's head, then shoot it with the wonder weapon to bring it up to its head.
   - While it's raining, get an Astral Flame and throw it at the head to strike it with lightning.
- Head to the nexus core to start the final boss fight.
